name: exercise_2_8_6
informal_prefix: /-- Prove that the center of the product of two groups is the product of their centers.-/
formal_statement:
noncomputable def exercise_2_8_6 {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] :
    center (G × H) ≃* (center G) × (center H) :=
goal:
G : Type u_1
H : Type u_2
inst✝¹ : Group G
inst✝ : Group H
⊢ ↥(center (G × H)) ≃* ↥(center G) × ↥(center H)

name: exercise_1_13b
informal_prefix: /-- Suppose that $f$ is holomorphic in an open set $\Omega$. Prove that if $\text{Im}(f)$ is constant, then $f$ is constant.-/
formal_statement:
theorem exercise_1_13b {f : ℂ → ℂ} (Ω : Set ℂ) (a b : Ω) (h : IsOpen Ω)
  (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω) (hc : ∃ (c : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ Ω, (f z).im = c) :
  f a = f b :=
goal:
f : ℂ → ℂ
Ω : Set ℂ
a b : ↑Ω
h : IsOpen Ω
hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω
hc : ∃ c, ∀ z ∈ Ω, (f z).im = c
⊢ f ↑a = f ↑b
